QUOTE: "It is forwarded only into `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} ... ref={ref} />`, which renders only when `hasSearch` is true (lines 128–138)." and "If `hasSearch` is false, the ref is silently dropped, because `NavigationSearch` is never rendered."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that NavigationHeader forwards its ref only to NavigationSearch, which renders only when hasSearch is true, and that otherwise the ref attaches to nothing.
